title: The translated Schur diagonals are positive and at most 1 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, all six Schur diagonals on survivors `0,1,2,7,8,9` are strictly positive and at most 1.
- Vertices 0 and 9 do not meet the interior, so those diagonals are exactly 1. The corrections at 1 and 8 lie strictly between `1/10^99` and `1/10^98`. The corrections at 2 and 7 lie strictly between `1/10^25` and `1/10^24`.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is one Schur section, not a proof that the reference matrix has diagonal 1 after every elimination.
